summary.text: Becca White is the Democratic incumbent state senator for the Windsor District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A former state representative who works as a community engagement organizer, she has served in the Senate since 2023.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca White was born in Lebanon, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont in 2015.
Her career experience includes work as a community engagement organizer with Efficiency Vermont.
White served in the Vermont House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023, including as clerk of the House Transportation Committee in 2019-2020, and joined the Senate in 2023.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Senate Government Operations Committee and the Senate Transportation Committee, where she is vice chair.
